items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: However, I did agree to go to New York and work for Barney Josephson for the first, you know, for eight weeks at least.

ctx.x: And sure enough, he did talk to Carlos Gastel and GAC, and of course Carlos worked very closely with GAC, you know, because he had Nat, Peggy Lee, Mel Torme, Stan Kenton, all of these people were GAC. So anyway, he talked to Mr. Gastel and got him interested in me, and well, it just started,

it just happened that way. However, I did agree to go to New York and work for Barney Josephson for the first, you know, for eight weeks at least. So after that time, then Carlos Gastel took over as my manager, and that's when things began to happen.
I worked theaters, nightclubs, and I continued to record, you know.
